clips.title: The story
paras: Kobolds now swarm through Fargodeep Mine, south of Goldshire in central Elwynn Forest. The mine once brought gold to Stormwind, but its tunnels are now a kobold warren.

Gold once flowed from Fargodeep Mine into Stormwind's treasury. As the Kingdom's military presence in Elwynn dwindled, outlying resources became vulnerable. Kobolds soon filled the mine's dark tunnels and made a warren beneath the hills. Marshal Dughan and Goldshire's authorities fear the lost ore and the danger to nearby farms, including the Stonefield and Maclure holdings.

Fargodeep Mine runs through several levels, with lower shafts reaching deep beneath the forest floor. Kobold laborers and vermin hurry along wooden scaffolds, guarding the wax and gold dust they have scavenged. Goldtooth, a cunning kobold leader, lurks in a den above the main tunnels. He hoards trinkets stolen from travelers and nearby residents.
